f.title: Notify and make public the package insert and other information specified in the Act
f.statement: Under the Act on Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices (Act No. 145, 1960) as revised by Act No. 84, 2013, marketing authorisation holders of drugs, medical devices, and cellular and tissue-based products are required to notify and make public the information specified in the Items of Article 52-1, Article 63-2-1, and Article 65-3-1 of the Act (package insert and other information).

f.legal_basis: Act on Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Article 52-1, Article 63-2-1, Article 65-3-1
f.applicability: Drugs, medical devices, and cellular and tissue-based products

rows.quote:
The Act for Ensuring the Quality, Efficacy, and Safety of Drugs, Medical Devices, and other products (Act No.
145, 1960. Hereinafter referred to as “the Act”) after revision by the Act for Partial Amendment of the
Pharmaceutical Affairs Act etc. (Act No. 84, 2013) requires marketing authorization holders of drugs,
medical devices, and cellular and tissue-based products to notify and make public of information specified in
the Items in Article 52-1, Article 63-2-1, and Article 65-3-1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “package
insert and other information”).

f.title: Collect and scientifically consider safety management information and stipulate procedures for safety-ensuring measures
f.statement: For marketing authorisation holders to develop appropriate safety-ensuring measures, including revision of package insert and other information, based on the latest safety management information: safety management information must be collected appropriately and scientifically considered; based on those results, procedures must be stipulated to enable development of safety-ensuring measures; and operations must be steadily conducted according to that procedure.

f.title: In periodic review, compare Precautions against CCDS/CCSI, foreign measures, literature, brand product and new interactions
